Excellent
Sep 2024 • Friends
Poke Hà Nội is a fantastic spot for a casual lunch with friends. The atmosphere is vibrant yet relaxed, making it perfect for a friendly gathering. The menu offers a variety of fresh, customizable poke bowls packed with flavors. You can choose from a range of fresh seafood, veggies, and sauces to create your own bowl or pick from their signature combinations. The ingredients are top-notch, and the portions are generous, ensuring a satisfying meal. The service is quick and friendly, which is ideal for a lunch break. Overall, it's a healthy, tasty, and fun dining option in Hanoi!

First time with poke Hanoi
Jul 2024 • Solo
This is my first time eating here, and the restaurant is really cosy, calm, and serene. In terms of the cuisine, I must state that it's standard, healthful, and excellent . However, the servings are excellent. The amount of food appears excessive for one person, making it somewhat challenging to finish it all by oneself. The price is quite high, but this is also likely due to the high calibre of the dish. Although the restaurant was a little busy at midday and the service was a little slow, I can perceive that the personnel at the restaurant is also quite amiable and transparent with their patrons. To sum up, everyone The portion will actually be very enormous, therefore people should try coming to eat once and should go with many of people.
